trajectory_summary: Call opened with unusually high customer energy — he'd just submitted the form and was struck by the speed — but the rep never capitalized on it, skipping verify/interest/bill capture and going straight into a vague bill-swap pitch. The customer's genuine curiosity curdled into repeated, unanswered financial questions, and by the end he politely exited to 'do some reading' with no next step locked. Energy leaked steadily from a strong open to a soft, ownerless close.
